title: Grassy Empanadas
description: Vegan empanadas filled with a mixture of sautéed grassy and silky ingredients, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Empanadas
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade vegan empanada wrappers

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add Uruguayan olive oil and sauté the silky mushrooms until tender.
Add chopped grassy leaves and cook until wilted.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place an empanada wrapper on a flat surface.
Spoon the grassy and silky mixture onto one half of the empanada wrapper.
Fold the other half over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Repeat with the remaining empanada wrappers and filling.
Serve the empanadas warm or at room temperature.
